summary: The change meets the request. It adds one short paragraph to the change verifier prompt. The paragraph tells verifiers to cite the recorded fmt, clippy and test results instead of rerunning the full suite. If a record failed or is missing, they run just that check, and they test new behavior with targeted `cargo test -p <crate> <filter>` commands. A CHANGELOG entry gives the reason: on 2026-10-18, verifiers that reran the full suite (about 11 minutes) timed out. Only the two expected files changed. Both runs were in this snapshot, not the real repository. For the full suite I relied on Athena's record ("cargo test --locked passed, 994 tests"), as the new instruction says, instead of rerunning it.
